verdict.rationale: Langfuse's docs explicitly support comparing prompt, model, or code changes side by side through UI- and SDK-driven experiments on datasets. The compare-experiments guide describes starting from aggregate scores, then drilling into cases that got worse and opening their traces, and CI/CD experiments can block deploys on regressions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the side-by-side comparison view, since community evidence mentions datasets and evals but not run comparison specifically.
